rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
# Make sure that ld is invoked from /usr/lib. case "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" in target) grep -rl '"[^"]*/lib\(32\|64\)\?/ld' * | while read filename; do sed -i 's@"[^"]*/lib\(32\|64\)\?/ld@"/usr/lib/ld@g' "$filename" done ;; tools) sed -i '/define LD_SO_CONF SYSCONFDIR/ s/ld\.so\.conf"/ld.so.tools-conf"/g' elf/ldconfig.c sed -i '/define LD_SO_CACHE SYSCONFDIR/ s/ld\.so\.cache"/ld.so.tools-cache"/g' sysdeps/generic/dl-cache.h
grep -rl '"[^"]*/lib\(32\|64\)\?/ld' * | while read filename; do sed -i 's@"[^"]*/lib\(32\|64\)\?/ld@"/tools/lib/ld@g' "$filename" done
patch -tN -p1 < "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/patches/bbox-redirect-bin-sh.patch"
sed -i -e "s/^OBJCOPY=.*/OBJCOPY=$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-objcopy/g" \ -e "s/^OBJDUMP=.*/OBJDUMP=$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-objdump/g" configure ;; esac
rm -fr .build && mkdir -p .build
( set -e cd .build
CFLAGS="" CXXFLAGS="" CPPFLAGS="" \ ../configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --with-headers="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-werror \ --disable-crypt \ --disable-build-nscd \ --disable-nscd \ --without-gd \ --without-cvs \ --enable-stackguard-randomization \ --enable-stack-protector=strong \ --enable-profile \ --enable-add-ons \ libc_cv_slibdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ libc_cv_rtlddir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib"
# Cheat our way around building the manual (which is not there). cat << EOF >> ../manual/empty-script.sh #!/bin/sh EOF
chmod +x ../manual/empty-script.sh
ln -sf empty-script.sh ../manual/libc-texinfo.sh ln -sf empty-script.sh ../manual/libm-err-tab.pl ln -sf empty-script.sh ../manual/xtract-typefun.awk
touch ../manual/libc.texinfo touch ../manual/libc.info )
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/.build" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
if [ -d "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/sbin" ]; then mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/sbin"/* \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/sbin/" rmdir "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/sbin" fi
mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/sbin/zdump" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/zdump"
export I18NPATH="$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/localedata" export GCONV_PATH="$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/.build/iconvdata"
install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/locale/" "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/localedef" \ --quiet -c -f UTF-8 -i C \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/locale/C.UTF-8"
install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share" install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/misc"
echo "glibc" > "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/misc/libc.name"
